gates.name: Aflatoxins (B1 and total)
gates.rule: B1 ≤ 10 µg/kg and total B1+B2+G1+G2 ≤ 15 µg/kg: PASS; any result above its threshold: FAIL; any missing result: TEST-FIRST.
gates.flip_condition: Representative composite: B1 ≤ 10 µg/kg AND total aflatoxins ≤ 15 µg/kg

gates.name: Rancidity / lipase
gates.rule: ffa > fail -> FAIL; test_first < ffa <= fail -> TEST-FIRST; ffa <= test_first and (stabilised or hours <= window) -> PASS; unmeasured, unstabilised and hours > window -> FAIL; else TEST-FIRST.

unstabilised_window_h.notes: raw bran under normal milling; applicability to DORB to verify

gates.name: Heavy metals
gates.rule: All four measured results ≤ their project thresholds: PASS; any exceedance: FAIL; otherwise TEST-FIRST.
gates.flip_condition: Lead ≤ 1.0; cadmium ≤ 0.1; total arsenic ≤ 0.5; mercury ≤ 0.1 mg/kg

gates.notes: Arsenic is treated as total arsenic; mg/kg is inferred from the neighbouring metal limits supplied by the user. An inorganic-arsenic-only assay does not establish total-arsenic compliance.

gates.name: Solvent residue
gates.rule: Measured hexane ≤ 10 mg/kg: PASS; > 10: FAIL. Without a measurement, explicit non-solvent processing passes this gate; solvent or unknown processing needs a quantitative residue result.
gates.flip_condition: Hexane residue ≤ 10 mg/kg (10 ppm), or confirmed non-solvent processing

hexane_residue.notes: User-specified project acceptance threshold (24 Oct 2026); not independently verified as a regulatory limit.

gates.name: Food-grade provenance
gates.rule: Require food-grade supply, hygienic storage, lot ID, supplier and traceability documentation. A microbiology panel alone does not prove provenance.
gates.flip_condition: documented lot, supplier, food-grade handling and storage records; microbiological verification as required

gates.name: Allergen
gates.rule: Always FLAG: major allergen; must be labelled; cannot support an allergen-free claim. Claim 'allergen_free' -> FAIL for that claim.

gates.name: Regulatory
gates.rule: Unknown category / intended-use regulatory review -> TEST-FIRST. A documented qualified review reference is required for pilot readiness; not a claim of approval.
